detect: (?m)^\s*(BTEQ \d+\.\d+|\*\*\* (Logon successfully completed|Query completed|Total elapsed time was))
parser:
import re def parse(lines): rule = re.compile(r'^\+-+(\+-*)*\s*$') dash = re.compile(r'^-+(\s+-+)*\s*$') sess_pats = [ (re.compile(r'Teradata Database Release is\s+(.+?)\s*$'), 'Release'), (re.compile(r'Teradata Database Version is\s+(.+?)\s*$'), 'Version'), (re.compile(r'Transaction Semantics are\s+(.+?)\.?\s*$'), 'Transaction Semantics'), (re.compile(r"Session Character Set Name is\s+'?(.+?)'?\.?\s*$"), 'Session Character Set Name'), (re.compile(r'RC \(return code\)\s*=\s*(\S+)'), 'RC'), ] blocks = [] skip = [] sess = {} sl = [] stmts = [] stl = [] cur = None expect = False ntab = 0 n = len(lines) i = 0 while i < n: s = lines[i] t = s.strip() if not t: i += 1 continue if rule.match(t): skip.append(i) expect = True i += 1 continue m = re.match(r'BTEQ\s+(?P\S+)\s+(?P.+?)\s+PID:\s*(?P

\d+)', t) if m: sess['BTEQ version'] = m.group('v') sess['Date'] = m.group('d') sess['PID'] = m.group('p') sl.append(i) i += 1 continue if t.startswith('***'): msg = t[3:].strip() done = False for rx, key in sess_pats: mm = rx.search(msg) if mm: sess[key] = mm.group(1) sl.append(i) done = True break if not done: if cur is None: cur = {'Statement': '', 'Message': '', 'Rows': '', 'Columns': '', 'Elapsed time': ''} stmts.append(cur) me = re.search(r'Total elapsed time was\s+(.+?)\.?\s*$', msg) if me: cur['Elapsed time'] = me.group(1) else: mq = re.search(r'(\S+) rows? found', msg) if mq: cur['Rows'] = mq.group(1) mc = re.search(r'(\S+) columns? returned', msg) if mc: cur['Columns'] = mc.group(1) cur['Message'] = (cur['Message'] + '; ' + msg) if cur['Message'] else msg stl.append(i) i += 1 continue if i + 1 < n and dash.match(lines[i + 1].strip()): d = lines[i + 1] spans = [(m2.start(), m2.end()) for m2 in re.finditer(r'-+', d)] names = [] for k, (a, b) in enumerate(spans): e = spans[k + 1][0] if k + 1 < len(spans) else None names.append(s[a:e].strip() if e is not None else s[a:].strip()) used = [i, i + 1] recs = [] j = i + 2 while j < n and lines[j].strip() and not rule.match(lines[j].strip()) and not lines[j].strip().startswith('***'): row = {} L = lines[j] for k, (a, b) in enumerate(spans): e = spans[k + 1][0] if k + 1 < len(spans) else None v = (L[a:e] if e is not None else L[a:]).strip() if v == '?': v = '' row[names[k]] = v recs.append(row) used.append(j) j += 1 ntab += 1 blocks.append({'name': 'result' if ntab == 1 else 'result_%d' % ntab, 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': recs}) i = j continue if expect or t.startswith('.'): parts = [] j = i while j < n and lines[j].strip() and not lines[j].strip().startswith('***') and not rule.match(lines[j].strip()): parts.append(lines[j].strip()) stl.append(j) j += 1 cur = {'Statement': ' '.join(parts), 'Message': '', 'Rows': '', 'Columns': '', 'Elapsed time': ''} stmts.append(cur) expect = False i = j continue i += 1 out = [] if sess: out.append({'name': 'session', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': sl, 'records': [sess]}) if stmts: out.append({'name': 'statements', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': stl, 'records': stmts}) out.extend(blocks) return {'blocks': out, 'skip': skip}
